changelog: Every poster of something in the library plays from where it sits: Hera's home rows, search and Seerr's In Your Library now show the same glass play disc over a light frost as Jellyfin's own posters, and Jellyfin's disc is the same size as Hera's. Trailers never show YouTube's "Video unavailable" page: the server asks YouTube which trailers may play outside youtube.com, post-play reveals a trailer only once it is playing and moves to the next if one fails, and a title page's Trailer button opens Hera's own full-screen trailer layer (or goes when none will play).
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
name: Hera TV
overview: The Apple TV app's look for Jellyfin's web client
